newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Euroyen, JGBs slide on Nissan Life news.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Euroyen, JGBs slide on Nissan Life news.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen futures fell in line with a sharp drop in Japanese government bond (JGB) futures on Friday morning as participants reacted to news that Nissan Life Insurance Co was to be liquidated.

Dealers said JGBs were sold off after Japan's Finance Ministry ordered Nissan Life to halt operations, sparking fears the company might be forced to sell some of its bond holdings. "Nissan Life holds about 300 billion yen worth of JGBs and about 700 billion yen worth of overseas bonds and the market was anticipating that they would need to dump these. So people started selling ahead of them," a trader at a European futures house said.
June JGBs stood at 125.98 at 0340 GMT after falling to a low of 125.90 against their previous close at 126.58.
The lead December Euroyen contract was at 98.98, two ticks above its morning low, against an IMM close at 99.04. Volume was a moderate 10,530 lots.
Dealers said further falls were likely to be limited, with June JGBs seen supported at 125.90 and 125.25.
"I wouldn't look too bearishly at the market. Japan's financial system is still prone to difficulties. So I'd like to buy the JGBs on dips," said the trader.
